Apple (AAPL) vs Coca Cola (KO): on the same formula, revenue grew +15.1% and +1.9% last fiscal year. The numbers side by side:

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AAPL: $478.8B · KO: $47.9B
• Revenue growth — AAPL: +15.1% · KO: +1.9%
• Operating margin — AAPL: 33.0% · KO: 28.7%
• Net margin — AAPL: 27.6% · KO: 27.3%
• Free cash flow margin — AAPL: 28.4% · KO: 11.0%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AAPL: 5.0% · KO: 5.5%

Different fiscal years: AAPL Sep 26, 2026 · KO Dec 31, 2025. The periods are not identical.
